answer_1.quote: LLMs have made notable strides in complex reasoning tasks, yet they face significant challenges in multi-step reasoning. Building on a single-path prompting, such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and its variants, recent research has investigated tree search-based methods for complex tasks that demand exploration in reasoning.
